description: Where a deployment is (every step), what it waits on (a health-check proposal or a manual step, and the call that answers it), and for a failed one: the kind of failure, what to do, and the last error lines. Defaults to the project's latest deployment. Changes nothing.

deployment_id.description: A specific deployment, instead of the latest

project.description: The project's id, name or repository. Optional with one project.

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this long for the status or step to change (no poll loop needed)

workspace.description: Act in a teammate's workspace: its id from account. Default: your own.

name: deployment
title: Deployment progress and failure guidance
